I've ported the LRU cache simulator to Zig. A clean build with `node check.mjs` passes all 5 example cases, and the 6 unit tests pass.

I also built the original Clojure version and compared the two directly. Their output was identical on four generated 1,000,000-command inputs with capacities of 1, 1,000, 100,000 and 1,000,000. It also matched on edge-case inputs: Windows line endings, blank lines, padding around the capacity, unknown commands, missing arguments and values containing spaces. Ea
